verdict.rationale: ClickUp's built-in Brain² AI reads your tasks, docs and conversations in real time. It answers complex questions from your workspace and connected apps, and the vendor explicitly promises "answers and insights" from that data inside the product. missing for 10: explicit evidence of proactive AI suggestions (as opposed to answers to questions), in-depth first-party docs beyond marketing taglines, and independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
